title: callicarpa longifolia var. lanceolaria
intro: Callicarpa longifolia var. lanceolaria, commonly known as the Purple Powderpuff, is a type of flowering plant in the Lamiaceae family. It is a shrub native to Southeast Asia and is valued for its potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and wounds, with therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Callicarpa longifolia var. lanceolaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits.
